_comment: GGUF artifacts a node may serve. Data, not code: adding a model to the
fleet is a catalog change plus a signed daemon release, so the set of
weights an operator's machine will run is reviewable in a diff.
sha256 is the pin. The daemon verifies it after download AND before
load, and refuses to serve a file that does not match. Artifacts are
fetched from MESHEMBED_GGUF_MIRROR, never from a third-party host: the
pin only means something if we can serve those exact bytes for the life
of a fleet generation, which an upstream repository does not promise.
min_ram_gb is measured against AVAILABLE memory, not installed, so a
workstation whose owner is using it does not get handed a model it
Every entry must pass both onboarding gates (MODEL_ONBOARDING_POLICY.md):
no torch/torchvision surface, and no code executed at load time. GGUF
PENDING MIRRORING -- the Phase 1 catalog in LLM_INFERENCE_DESIGN.md par.3
also names salamandra-7b-instruct and mistral-7b-instruct. They are not
listed here because no digest has been verified for them yet: the
artifacts must first be mirrored and pinned. Writing an unverified sha256
into this file would defeat the entire point of the file.

models.note: Apache-2.0. Small enough for any office machine and for CPU-only nodes. Suited to the prefill-dominant shapes in par.11: classification, tagging, routing, short extraction. Not a summarisation or reasoning model.
